# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt

Compare progression reflection with quest promotion when reviewed evidence shows mastery movement across several axes rather than one repeated quest unit.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

The evidence is about capability movement and unlock hints, not final promotion
of one repeated quest unit.

## Expected object

A bounded progression delta that stays evidence-backed and multi-axis.

## Boundary notes

This is a session-progression-lift case, not a quest-harvest case.

## Verification hooks

- cite reviewed evidence for every delta
- keep movement multi-axis instead of one global score
- avoid granting hidden routing authority
